stamped-checklist:must/001.reason: The complete delivery has one common workspace root containing inputs, code, report and generated results.

evidence.description: Supplied task is within the workspace root.
Report is within the same workspace root.

stamped-checklist:must/002.reason: All 54 map links resolve to annex objects retained beneath the same workspace root; metadata and source checksums identify the inputs.

evidence.description: Relative symlink to retained .git/annex object.
Input manifest names all 54 maps and source checksums.

stamped-checklist:must/003.reason: The delivered script depends on externally installed Python packages and an absolute host interpreter; no environment package specification or linked software module is included.

evidence.description: Documented interpreter is an absolute path; no installation or environment specification.
Imports scientific packages, while the delivery has no environment declaration.

stamped-checklist:must/004.reason: At worker stop the report, code, notebook and results were outside the Git index and untracked; the captured commit does not version the complete work.

evidence.description: Captured Git index at worker stop.
Worker report is present in complete delivery but absent from the captured tracked tree.
Worker script is present in complete delivery but absent from the captured tracked tree.

stamped-checklist:must/005.reason: The supplied large participant maps are represented by 54 git-annex links with retained annex content. This is inherited input organization, not a newly established worker action.

evidence.description: One of the 54 annex-managed input maps.
Annex object store retained in the captured repository.

stamped-checklist:must/006.reason: The complete delivery has outputs and a software-version summary, but no exact environment specification linked to the run that produced those outputs.

evidence.description: Records Python, NumPy and nibabel versions only; not the complete environment.
Documents invocation but not an exact environment manifest or run-linked environment record.

stamped-checklist:must/007.reason: report.md gives a run command but no installation instructions; the probe missed this equivalent documentation because it was not tracked.

evidence.description: Report contains usage instructions but does not provide the required README or Makefile entry.

stamped-checklist:must/008.reason: The report names scripts/analyze.py as the analysis entrypoint and gives a runnable command; the script implements the group workflow.

evidence.description: Reproducibility section names the script and command.
Complete group-analysis implementation.

stamped-checklist:must/009.reason: The analysis script constructs input and output paths relative to its own location rather than embedding data paths.

evidence.description: ROOT derives from __file__; inputs and outputs are rooted relative to the script.

evidence.description: Imports matplotlib, nibabel, numpy, pandas, scipy, threadpoolctl and nilearn.

evidence.description: No operating-system, system-library or environment-variable requirements are documented.

stamped-checklist:must/012.reason: No README or environment file lists system requirements and complete software dependencies.

evidence.description: No dependency installation or system-requirement list.

stamped-checklist:must/014.reason: No environment specification or tracked dependency-update process is documented.

evidence.description: No process for updating dependencies or specifications is described.

stamped-checklist:must/015.reason: No complete frozen package manifest, container digest or equivalent environment pin is supplied.

evidence.description: A few library versions are reported, but no exact environment pin.

evidence.description: No environment publication or retrieval route is identified.

evidence.description: No environment acquisition instructions.
